attempt.title: Record contact attempt
attempt.intro: Record each try to reach the patient, even when it did not succeed.
attempt.phoneSimulated: Phone calls are simulated in this demo — no call is made.
attempt.noteHint: Short and factual. Do not record diagnoses.
attempt.reachedHint: Reaching the patient moves the task to Contacted.

outcome.title: Record outcome
outcome.attendedHint: The patient attended the referred appointment or visit.
outcome.referredOnwardHint: The patient was directed to the destination the clinician set.
outcome.unableToReachHint: The patient could not be reached after trying.
outcome.noDestination: No referral destination on this device
outcome.referredCaption: The clinician confirms when the referral is complete.
outcome.unableCaption: Your supervisor or clinician will decide next steps.
outcome.attendedCaption: A clinician confirms the completion afterwards.
outcome.reason: Why could the patient not be reached?
outcome.inlineAttemptHint: Saved as a "Not reached" attempt at the time above, before the outcome.
outcome.noteHint: Short and factual. Do not record diagnoses.

evidence.appointment_card_seen: You saw the patient's appointment card.
evidence.worker_accompanied_visit: You went with the patient to the visit.
evidence.patient_verbal_confirmation: The patient told you they attended.

confirmCompletion: This marks the follow-up as completed

errors.conflict: This task changed since you opened it. Nothing was overwritten — go back and open it again.
errors.failed: Could not save on this device. Try again.

blocked.completed: This follow-up is already completed. No further outcome can be recorded.
blocked.needs_reached_attempt: Record a contact attempt where the patient was reached before marking them as attended.
blocked.already_unable_to_reach: Unable to reach is already recorded. Your supervisor or clinician will decide next steps.
blocked.already_referred_onward: Referred onward is already recorded for this task.
blocked.not_allowed: This outcome cannot be recorded for the task in its current state.

savedOnDeviceBody: It will be sent when the simulated sync runs.

notAccepted.title: Not accepted by the simulated server
notAccepted.body: This task is no longer assigned to you or is outside your facility. Your record is kept on this device.
